snippet.title: Real Madrid vs Barcelona: Who Really Owns El Clásico?
snippet.description:
Real Madrid vs Barcelona: from Messi vs Ronaldo to Lamine Yamal vs Kylian Mbappé, this is the story of El Clásico’s changing balance of power.

Ahead of Barcelona vs Real Madrid on 25 October 2026, FootballUnfiltered revisits the goals, celebrations and turning points that shaped football’s fiercest rivalry.

We finish with a closer look at two Yamal and Mbappé goals: the space outside, the run inside, and what those moments reveal about the next Clásico.

snippet.title: Every Ballon d’Or Winner on a Map (1956–2025)
snippet.description:
Every Ballon d’Or winner from 1956 to 2025, visualized on maps. Explore the players, clubs, voting results and rivalries behind football’s most famous individual award — then join the debate over who should win in 2026.

From Stanley Matthews and Alfredo Di Stéfano to Johan Cruyff, Marco van Basten, Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo and Ousmane Dembélé, follow the history of the men’s Ballon d’Or year by year.

See who each winner beat, compare their voting results and follow the race between clubs including Real Madrid, Barcelona, AC Milan and Bayern Munich.

We also revisit the cancelled 2020 Ballon d’Or and the Robert Lewandowski debate, before sharing our take on the 2026 contenders: Michael Olise, Kylian Mbappé, Harry Kane and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.

🏆 Who is your pick for the 2026 Ballon d’Or?

snippet.title: €0 Mbappé vs €60M Haaland: Cost Per Goal
snippet.description:
Real Madrid signed Mbappé for €0. Man City paid €60M for Haaland. So why was the free one more expensive per goal? 🤯

Clubs don't pay a transfer fee in one go — they spread it over the contract. Haaland's €60M fee works out to €12M a year; add around €22M in reported wages and City paid roughly €34.6M a year. Mbappé cost €0 in fees, but a reported €15M net salary plus a signing bonus of at least €25M a year makes him €40M+ a year.

Divide by first-season goals (Haaland 52 in the 2022-23 treble season, Mbappé 43 in 2024-25) and Haaland cost about €670K per goal, Mbappé around €1M. Haaland's wage is reported gross and Mbappé's net, so the real gap is even bigger.

Haaland / Year: €34,600,000
Haaland Goals: 52
Haaland per Goal: ~€670,000

snippet.title: PSG Paid €4 Million for EVERY Neymar Goal 🤯
snippet.description:
PSG paid €489 million for Neymar. That's over €4 million for every goal he scored in Paris 💸

In 2017, Paris Saint-Germain triggered Neymar's €222M release clause at Barcelona: still the biggest transfer in football history, more than double the previous world record. But the transfer fee was only half the bill. Leaked contract figures show around €43M a year in wages for five years, plus a sixth-year option worth another €50M.

What did PSG get back? 173 games, 118 goals, 5 Ligue 1 titles… and zero Champions League trophies, the one thing he was signed to win (they lost the 2020 final to Bayern). In 2023 PSG sold him to Al-Hilal for around €90M, leaving a net loss of almost €400 million.

🧾 THE RECEIPT
Transfer fee: €222,000,000
Wages (5 yrs): €216,672,000
6th-year option: €50,556,117
Total paid: €489,228,117
Sold to Al-Hilal: ~€90,000,000
Net loss: ~€399,000,000
Champions League titles: 0

So was Neymar the worst signing in football history, or worth every cent? 👇 Drop your verdict in the comments: ROBBERY or WORTH IT?
